# VAULTX

> VAULTX is a concept streetwear store from Prague: heavyweight hoodies, tees, outerwear, denim and caps in black, grey and bone, with a few loud colourways. It is a portfolio project; no real orders or payments are processed.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://denysovski.github.io/VaultX/): Drop 07 Curfew, the brand story and delivery promises
- [Shop](https://denysovski.github.io/VaultX/shop/): all products with filters for category, colour, size, price and stock
- [Bunker Hoodie](https://denysovski.github.io/VaultX/shop/bunker-hoodie/): 520 gsm hoodie, three colours
- [Lookbook](https://denysovski.github.io/VaultX/lookbook/): photos by Christian Agbede on Unsplash
- [Help desk](https://denysovski.github.io/VaultX/help/): order tracking, delivery problems, returns, FAQ and contact
- [Terms](https://denysovski.github.io/VaultX/terms/) and [Privacy](https://denysovski.github.io/VaultX/privacy/)
